info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Facility By Param1-spec
info.description: The Facility Lookup API allows users to retrieve detailed information about specific banking facilities based on a unique parameter. This endpoint is particularly useful for financial analysts and operations teams seeking to understand facility attributes and status. By providing a specific identifier, consumers can access relevant data to inform decision-making or facilitate customer interactions. Use cases include tracing facility details for regulatory compliance or operational management.

get.summary: Retrieve site operation details for a specific facility.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific site operation identified by its unique ID. It is useful for viewing operational parameters, schedules, and statuses associated with the facility in question.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve site operations for the specified facility. It should contain all necessary parameters to ensure accurate data retrieval.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the site operations details.

GetFacilityByParam1Request.title: Site Operations Request Body
GetFacilityByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the Site Operations GET request.

GetFacilityByParam1Response_200.title: Site Operations Response

assetId.description: Unique identifier for the asset associated with the operation.

workOrderId.description: Unique identifier for the work order related to the operation.

facilityZone.description: Zone within the facility where the operation takes place.

maintenanceType.description: Type of maintenance being performed during the operation.

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: Estimated duration of the operation in minutes.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the operation record.

version.description: Version indicator for the operation record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the operation details were last updated.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the operation response.

GetFacilityByParam1Response_200.description: Response schema for site operations inquiry, including details about the site and associated operations.
